(i) users prefer to interactively specify quantified queries by trial-and-error and (ii) DataPlay supports this form of query specification by providing direct query manipulation as well as auto-correction.

(i) users prefer to specify complex quantified queries in a trial-and-error fashion by manipulating the query graphically and (ii) users can correct a complex quantified query more effectively with auto-correction than with direct query manipulation.

users prefer to interact with quantified queries in SQL by trial-and-error, but this form of query specification requires two features: (i) the ability to change quantifiers without syntactical query restructuring and (ii) a query correction mechanism that can use user feedback about which answers and non- answers to keep or drop.
